name: GJ B2B PC Design Skill Resource Index
pathBase: All relative paths are resolved from references/library-index.json.

audiencePolicy.ai-readable: AI 在选择规则、Token、组件和图标时可按需读取。
audiencePolicy.output-asset: AI 可在 HTML/CSS 原型中加载或复用，但不得当作指令文档或真实前端组件库 API。
audiencePolicy.maintenance-script: 仅在对应来源更新、校验或显式迁移任务中运行，不作为规则来源读取。
audiencePolicy.human-preview-only: 只用于人工视觉与交互验收；不是设计真值、生产组件源码或 AI 默认参考入口。

lookupRules: Resolve a component through components/inventory.json schemaRegistry; do not maintain another component list here.
Resolve an icon catalog through icons/index.json; do not copy its manifest list into this file.

For a high-frequency component token, replace <component-kebab> with the inventory alias normalized to lowercase kebab-case, for example text-button or input. A missing file means the component token has not been engineered yet; do not invent it.

styles.policy: Only these two stylesheets are normal HTML/CSS prototype workflow entries.

fonts.policy: Font selection and allowed weights are defined by aiWorkflow.styles.fontPolicy; do not infer them from filenames.

tokenBuild.runWhen: A token, typography, effect, gradient, layout, or registered component-token source changes.

coverageBuild.runWhen: After inventory status changes or a component rules, schema, mapping, audit, component-token, or preview artifact is added or removed.

validation.runWhen: After token builds or changes to registered contracts, shared styles, runtimes, or preview integration.

semanticColorMigration.runWhen: Only when an explicit legacy semantic-color migration is requested; never run as part of normal generation.

pageVerification.runWhen: 生成或修改任一页面模式、组件预览页或业务原型之后，按 generation-verification.md 的协议执行；依赖 Playwright，已在仓库根目录 package.json 声明，首次使用前执行一次 npm install。涉及预览页/模式页或共享样式的提交还会被本地提交门禁（scripts/git-hooks/）自动调用一次。

cascader.initializes: [data-gj-cascader-field] Selector trigger and floating Cascader panel

previewRuntimes.policy: These scripts support the human preview and page-pattern prototypes. They are not production component-library source or a frontend API contract.

legacyStyles.policy: Do not load in new pages, page patterns, or Skill deliverables.

humanPreviewSite.policy: Use only for visual and interaction acceptance after reading the AI workflow sources. Never infer a missing component contract or Token from preview-page private CSS.

loadingRules: Start from aiWorkflow and read only the branches required by the task.
Load primitiveColors only for raw palette lookup or alias resolution; use semanticColors for component and page color decisions.
Resolve components and icons through their single child indexes instead of duplicating their catalogs here.
HTML/CSS prototypes load outputAssets.styles.loadOrder in order.
Run scripts.tokenBuild after Token sources change, scripts.coverageBuild after component coverage changes, and scripts.validation before delivery.
Do not read humanPreviewSite or scripts.previewRuntimes as design truth; use them only for implementation and human acceptance when the task requires a preview.
